#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

int modpow(int a, int b) {
    if (a == 0) return 0;
    int res = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) res = (1LL * res * a) % MOD;
        a = (1LL * a * a) % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int modmul(int a, int b) {
    return (1LL * a * b) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    long long kl;
    cin >> n >> kl;
    if (kl >= n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    int k = (int)kl;

    vector<int> fact(n + 1), ifact(n + 1, 0);
    fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = modmul(fact[i - 1], i);
    }

    auto ifact_func = [&](int x) -> int {
        if (ifact[x] != 0) return ifact[x];
        return ifact[x] = modpow(fact[x], MOD - 2);
    };

    int ans = 0;
    int mult = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n - k; ++i, mult = -mult) {
        long long term = 1LL * mult * modpow(n - k - i, n);
        term %= MOD;
        if (term < 0) term += MOD;
        int add = (int)term;
        add = modmul(add, fact[n - k]);
        add = modmul(add, ifact_func(i));
        add = modmul(add, ifact_func(n - k - i));
        ans += add;
        if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
    }

    ans = modmul(ans, fact[n]);
    ans = modmul(ans, ifact_func(k));
    ans = modmul(ans, ifact_func(n - k));

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << ans << '\n';
    } else {
        cout << modmul(ans, 2) << '\n';
    }

    return 0;
}
